body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 76916da509230bb98bdc0614a43f67de5296b018 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Reviewed head 76916da against current main (010bca6), trial-merged locally.

### What looks good
- The axis is still fitted to the part alone; the stock only widens the ladder top (`crates/motion/src/turning/face.rs:115-123`), the rung bands (`face.rs:169-175`) and the rapids radius. Stock is read in the part's frame, as the comment says.
- Stock profile errors propagate with `?`; no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` added in `src`.
- The refusal text now names both the part and its stock, so the "nothing to face" case stays a named refusal.
- The `facing.nc` golden change is explained and checked: passes start at the r6 bar plus nose (outside the raw bar), rapids and other lines are unchanged.
- The `lathe_spindle_law` fixture change (box stock moves with the bar and G54) is the right consequence of facing now reading the stock.

### Local results (trial merge with main)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-motion --test turning_face` | 7 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-app --test drill_prior` | 12 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-app --test lathe_post` | 7 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test lathe_post_refusals` | 5 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test lathe_spindle_law` | 8 passed |
| `camcraft-app --test turning` / `turning_axial_rapids` / `turning_blade` / `turning_bore` / `turning_bore_feeds` / `turning_contour` / `turning_form` / `turning_profile` / `turning_stock_approach` / `turning_thread` | 5 / 2 / 14 / 11 / 3 / 10 / 8 / 6 / 3 / 8 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --lib -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Full `camcraft-app` test build does not compile on main as well (see note 1), so the suites above were run as individual `--test` binaries.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. Main itself does not build the app test target `drilling_cross_part`: `crates/app/tests/drilling_cross_part.rs:50` builds `Operation` without the `coolant` field that `crates/app/src/schema.rs:176` now has (`error[E0063]: missing field 'coolant'`). This PR does not touch that file; the maintainer should fix it on main, separately.
2. The branch is behind main on `RECOMMENDED.md` (append-only conflict). On merge, keep both sides.
3. The `#159` limitation (posting the whole face-then-drill program is still refused by the footprint rapid law) is stated in the PR body and is out of scope here.
4. Pre-existing failures named in the PR body (`drilling_axial`, `swarf_pose_continuity`) are in binaries this PR does not touch; I did not run them.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
